small_guidance: Eval harness runs with training=True, so the BN path uses running stats updates and per-batch statistics — the current forward calls bn(y) in training but then ALSO subtracts the spatial mean correctly; the numerical mismatch (max diff 0.014) likely comes from float32 atomic_add nondeterminism/order in the scatter conv plus running-stat drift. Tighten correctness by (a) accumulating conv output in fp32 with deterministic gather instead of atomic scatter, or (b) ensuring conv_bias is added inside the conv kernel epilogue (not after) so BN sees the exact reference tensor. Also add larger BLOCK_OC=128/BLOCK_IC=32 autotune configs once a small tile compiles.
large_guidance: Redesign the ConvTranspose3d as a gather-based im2col GEMM: one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile), where each output voxel loops over (kd,kh,kw,ic) gathering the corresponding input voxel (with stride/pad inverse indexing and validity mask) — this removes atomic_add entirely, yields deterministic fp32 accumulation, and lets you fuse conv_bias add directly in the epilogue. Then run a single fused BN+spatial-mean-subtract kernel: one program per (N,C), two-pass over D*H*W computing y=x*scale+shift, sum, then store y-mean. This eliminates the training/eval branch mismatch — always apply BN via folded running stats path or via a two-pass Welford if training stats are required, but apply it unconditionally so the result is reproducible.
